name: erp_customer_payments_list
description: List customer payment transactions, optionally filtered by customer entity or the invoice they were applied to (GET /services/rest/record/v1/customerPayment)

applied_to.description: Invoice tranId the payment was applied against, e.g. INV-1002; unapplied payments have an empty value.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
